reasons: First time you have paid this person

sections.title: How things look
sections.text: There is one payment we would like to talk through with you. Please speak to your helper on Tuesday, or use the number on the back of your bank card.

sections.title: Last month
sections.text: In November, £1,280 came in. A payment of £2,000 went to someone new, and your rent (£480) and council tax (£118) were paid as usual. You took out £160 in cash. £1,770 more went out than came in.

sections.title: The next three months
sections.text: December looks comfortable, with about £990 spare because you get two pension payments. January looks tight, with about £15 spare, mainly because your TV licence of £175 is due. February looks fine, with about £348 spare.

sections.title: Scam watch
sections.text: On 18 November, £2,000 was paid to someone you have not paid before, late in the evening. That is much more than your usual payments. If this was you, there is nothing to do. If it was not, please talk to us as soon as you can. We will never ask for your details in a letter.

sections.title: Since your last visit
sections.text: Nothing new since we last spoke.

sections.title: Ask a question
sections.text: If you have a question, tick a box on the slip or ask your helper on Tuesday. Daria or a colleague will reply by letter.
